name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain battle (operates on data_fd2_battle_scene_snapshot), descriptor accurately describes the action (convert encoded tiles into a packed 24px tile bank). The '24px' refers to the 24x24 (0x18) tile dimensions written into the output header (semantic constant, not an address residue). No Ghidra address residue in the name; '24' is a real pixel dimension, not a hex address fragment.
purpose: Rebuild data_fd2_battle_scene_snapshot's RLE-encoded tile data into a freshly malloc'd 24x24 8bpp packed tile bank (6-byte header + tile_count packed 0x240-byte tiles), returning the new buffer.
logic_summary: Reads tile_count = *(uint16*)(snapshot+4). Allocates tile_count*0x240 + 6 bytes; on malloc failure prints 'Out of memory at rease shape !!!' and exit(1). Writes 6-byte header (uint16 width=0x18, uint16 height=0x18, uint16 tile_count) then zero-fills the tile region. For each tile i in [0,tile_count): src = snapshot + *(int32*)(snapshot + 6 + i*4) (offset-table entry -> tile's RLE stream), dst = bank + 6 + i*0x240; calls fd2_tile_blit_24x24_passthrough(src, dst, 0x18) to decode that tile into its 24x24 cell. Returns bank pointer (original tail-JMPs to shared epilogue at 0x10c49 with EAX=bank).

returns.semantics: Pointer to the newly malloc'd 24px tile bank (6-byte header + tile_count*0x240 packed-tile bytes). Returned via EAX in the original. Callers assign it into data_fd2_battle_scene_snapshot as a temporary 24px-resolution cache and free it after use.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment said the malloc-failure path tail-JMPs into _main's shared printf("%s")+exit(1) error path. That is slightly inaccurate: the shared stub at 0x10056 is printf(msg)+exit(1) where msg is the pushed string itself (no "%s" indirection), and the emitted C expands it inline to printf("Out of memory at rease shape !!!\n")+exit(1). Rest of the comment (layout, header, RLE decode, callers) was accurate.
notes: Verified against disasm @ 0x1399c: PUSH 0x20/__CHK, load [0x53a5d]=data_fd2_battle_scene_snapshot, MOVZX word [+4]=tile_count, size = tile_count*9<<6 (=*0x240) + 6, malloc @ 0x36d16, null -> PUSH 0x50122 / JMP 0x10056 (shared printf(msg)+exit(1) stub), header writes 0x18/0x18/tile_count, memset @ 0x375c0, loop calls blit @ 0x4deda (fd2_tile_blit_24x24_passthrough), MOV EAX,EDI / JMP 0x10c49 (return bank via shared epilogue). String @ 0x50122 confirmed 'Out of memory at rease shape !!!\n' (vendor 'rease' typo real). Callee 0x4deda confirmed as RLE sprite blit with arg3=row stride 0x18. Caller fd2_open_tactical_overview_zoom @ 0x2000a confirms output use: tile_attr*0x240 + 6 indexing into the converted bank, matching the 6-byte-header + 0x240/tile layout. Decompiler in_stack_* vars are __CHK stack-probe artifacts, not real params; function is genuinely void(void).
